widgets_values:
阶段 A（只需先跑一次）：启用两个 Mask Preview 检查目标；确认后启用 Save isolated target，生成黑底目标运动参考。

阶段 B：把原视频、SAM3_isolated_target.mp4 和替换人物图片添加到下方素材规划台。原视频与隔离视频都设为“可编辑参考”，隔离视频不要带音频。完成后把本组输出重新设为 Never，避免每次重复跟踪。

唯一比例开关：
TRUE（默认）＝跟随输入视频宽高比，百万像素在“输入视频模式”节点设置。
FALSE＝使用H3官方 Resolution Selector，在同一节点选择比例与百万像素。

两个模式都按32倍数输出，并同时连接短片诊断与真正长视频规划台。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the stylized 3D brown bear character defined by <Picture 1>. It has a very large rounded square-shaped head, small rounded ears with light inner surfaces, short chocolate-brown fur, a compact torso, short legs, short rounded paws, a beige muzzle, a small dark-brown nose, thick expressive eyebrows, and large asymmetrical cream-colored eyes with small black pupils. Its left eye is wide open while its right eye is slightly narrowed, creating a naturally skeptical and confused expression. Preserve the bear's exact facial proportions, fur color, eye asymmetry, eyebrow shape, muzzle, body proportions, and rounded 3D animated appearance. The orange background and floating question mark in <Picture 1> are not part of <Subject 1> and must never appear in the target video.

<Subject 2> is the nighttime urban street and bus-stop environment from <Video 1>, including the empty road, glass-and-metal bus shelter, distant dark building surfaces, cool blue-green street lighting, restrained background depth, and the original spatial arrangement.

<Subject 3> is the complete physical performance of the male character in <Video 1>, including his body position, gaze direction, mouth movement, head movement, shoulder rhythm, forward pointing gesture, raised emphasizing hand, lowered-arm pauses, forward lean, final forceful hand gesture, facial intensity, and exact action timing.

<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit. It defines the complete 7.76-second duration, single-shot structure, framing, camera position, camera movement, performance timing, scene continuity, and lighting changes.

<Audio 1> is the complete synchronized soundtrack of <Video 1>, including the original spoken dialogue, street ambience, physical movement sounds, and any existing score. Its speaking voice is assigned to <Subject 1> (S1) and is reused without changing the original wording or timing.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The original male character is removed completely and replaced by <Subject 1>, while the bear performs the complete frame-matched physical performance of <Subject 3>. The nighttime environment, framing, camera behavior, pacing, lighting, and synchronized soundtrack remain consistent with <Video 1>. The source subtitles, platform watermark, account information, search label, and other graphic overlays are removed.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the brown bear's rounded head, compact body, chocolate-brown fur, beige muzzle, dark nose, asymmetrical eyes, thick eyebrows, short paws, and stylized 3D proportions from <Picture 1> remain visually stable throughout the video.

<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the original nighttime road, bus shelter, background structures, spatial depth, and cool blue-green lighting from <Video 1> remain unchanged except for the removal of graphic overlays.

<Subject 3> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the original male performer's complete pose sequence, gesture timing, mouth rhythm, gaze, head motion, shoulder movement, emotional escalation, and final emphasis are transferred frame-for-frame to <Subject 1>, adapted only to the bear's shorter arms and compact anatomy.

<Video 1> (complete duration, framing, camera movement, lighting, and temporal structure): partially_preserved - the source video's single-shot structure, timing, camera behavior, scene, and lighting are retained, while the human performer and all embedded subtitles, watermarks, and interface graphics are removed.

<Audio 1>: fully_copy - the complete synchronized soundtrack from <Video 1> is reused 1:1, with the original voice now visually performed by <Subject 1> (S1).

detailed_description:
The target video combines the stylized high-quality 3D character design of <Subject 1> with the realistic cinematic nighttime environment and original shot structure of <Video 1>. The final duration is exactly 7.76 seconds. The result remains one continuous medium shot with no cuts.

[Shot 1] The shot begins with the same composition, camera height, focal-length feeling, subject placement, and nighttime bus-stop background established by <Video 1>. <Subject 2> remains fixed in its original position. The original male character is absent from every frame.

<Subject 1> occupies the original man's on-screen position and approximately the same total screen area. The bear is framed from its upper legs to above its head, allowing its torso, head, shoulders, and both paws to remain visible. It wears no suit, shirt, tie, shoes, or other human clothing. Its orange reference background and floating question mark are absent.

The cool blue-green street lighting from <Video 1> falls naturally across the bear's brown fur. Subtle cool highlights define the upper edges of its ears, head, muzzle, shoulders, and paws, while soft shadow remains beneath its chin and around the side of its compact body. The bear casts physically consistent contact and environmental shadows and appears naturally integrated into the original live-action space.

At the opening, <Subject 1> (S1) reproduces the original male performer's initial body angle, gaze direction, shoulder position, and forceful speaking rhythm from <Subject 3>. It turns its large head toward the same off-screen target and thrusts one short paw forward in the same direct pointing gesture. The paw direction, extension timing, torso rotation, and moment of emphasis match <Video 1> exactly.

The bear's eyebrows, eyelids, pupils, muzzle, and mouth animate in synchronization with <Audio 1>. Its mouth performs the complete source dialogue with accurate syllable timing and emotionally forceful lip synchronization. The original spoken wording and cadence are copied verbatim from <Audio 1>; no new dialogue is introduced.

Following the source performance frame-for-frame, the bear holds the forward point briefly, then swings the same paw upward beside its head in a sharp emphasizing motion. Its other paw remains positioned according to the original performer's opposite hand. The bear raises its chin, opens its mouth wider, and intensifies its eyebrows and eye focus at exactly the same moments as the man in <Video 1>.

During the middle section, <Subject 1> lowers its paw according to the source motion and returns to a squared frontal posture. It continues speaking with the same pauses, mouth rhythm, restrained head movements, shoulder tension, and fixed off-screen gaze. The asymmetrical eyes from <Picture 1> remain recognizable but respond naturally through blinking, narrowing, and widening without changing their size, placement, or identity.

During the final emotional rise, the bear reproduces the original man's forward lean and forceful concluding gesture. One paw rises rapidly in the same direction and follows the original hand trajectory with anatomy-aware adaptation: the short rounded paw remains unmistakably part of the bear and never becomes a human hand or finger. Its mouth opens widely at the source performance's loudest moment, its eyebrows compress with determination, and its compact torso shifts forward with the same timing and intensity.

The bear completes the final gesture, lowers the paw according to <Video 1>, and holds the same firm ending posture and severe off-screen stare through the final frame. Its fur, facial geometry, eyes, paws, body scale, and lighting remain stable during the entire performance.

Preserve the source video's exact camera position, subtle camera movement, framing, depth of field, background exposure, motion cadence, and action timing. Do not add cuts, zooms, new camera movement, new characters, additional props, or new actions.

High-quality stylized 3D character composited convincingly into a live-action cinematic environment, stable bear identity, stable fur pattern, stable eye asymmetry, correct paw count, physically coherent body motion, accurate motion transfer, precise dialogue synchronization, natural secondary fur movement, consistent shadows, and restrained motion blur. No remaining human body or human face, no human hands, no human clothing, no hybrid human-bear anatomy, no character morphing, no changing eye size, no duplicated paws, no extra fingers, no orange studio background, no floating question mark, no subtitles, no captions, no Douyin watermark, no account name, no search bar, no interface graphics, and no readable overlay text.

overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is fully copied as the target video's synchronized soundtrack, preserving the original dialogue timing, voice, street ambience, and physical movement sounds without alteration. No additional sound effects or replacement dialogue are added.

non_diegetic_music:
Any non-diegetic music already contained in <Audio 1> is reused unchanged as part of the fully copied source soundtrack. No new music is added.
